title: Mixing: Dear Yoko by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

A mixing session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 11 October 1980.

This session saw the completion of Lennon’s song ‘Dear Yoko’. The song had been recorded on 15, 25, and 29 August, and 22 September 1980.
